idea-plugin.name: Seqcall
idea-plugin.description:
See how your code behaves. Seqcall draws an interactive sequence diagram of the method at the caret, together with a live class diagram of the classes taking part. Open the calls that matter and click any element to jump to the code.

Works with TypeScript / JavaScript, C# and PHP (Laravel and plain PHP 8).

Getting started

  1. Put the caret inside a function or method.
  2. Press Ctrl+Alt+Shift+K, or right-click and choose Show Sequence Diagram.
  3. The diagram opens in the Seqcall tool window; Tools | Show Class Diagram opens the class diagram.

Or start from the ⌂ Entry points button: routes, main, jobs and tests.

What you can do

  • Expand step by step: ⊕ / ⊖ on a call; ✦ Overview opens the important calls for you; ↯ folds the error handling.
  • Jump to the code: click a message, participant or frame.
  • See conditions and loops: alt, opt, loop and try frames.
  • Spot I/O: badges mark calls that reach a database, the network or the disk.
  • Check the architecture: classes grouped by layer, dependency-rule violations in red, design findings such as I/O in a loop.
  • See the whole codebase: ⛶ Codebase in the class diagram shows every class the entry points reach, folder by folder.
  • Find your way: find calls and classes, show callers, list every path from the entry points to a method, review a branch.

Requirements

  • Node.js 20 or newer (found on the PATH or in nvm; otherwise set it under Settings | Tools | Seqcall).
  • C#: the .NET 10 runtime and the SDK your solution uses, with packages restored.

Preview: hidden classes and diagram options are not yet kept across IDE restarts.
